source_and_action_receipt_audit.scope: Replay frozen lexical adapter, independently reconstruct point/status/cost/action and feedback; no model generation or scoring reference.

native_llm_plus_verifier.scope: Post-run passive checks on the paid native EOS responses. No change to generation, no direct optimality certification.

budget_matched_paid_native_resampling.scope: Uses only the three paid native continuations. Stops before the next full natural continuation would exceed either measured GPU-work cap; may leave surplus. Same checker cap; no additional generated trace.

fixed_trace_point_budget_sensitivity.scope: Rechecks observed candidate order only. New budgets do not change generation in this analysis and cannot establish a live accuracy curve.

clock_accounting.scope: Elapsed clocks measured around GPU/CPU work. Not GPU kernel busy time. Resident allocation includes pause.
